text:
Submerged Object - Mooring Prohibited - Port of Trois-Rivieres - Trois-Rivières
Submerged debris reported at wharf 11 at the port of Trois-Rivières. Debris extends 3 metres from the wharf. Mooring at bollards 11-4 and 11-5 is prohibited.
